purpose: Purchasable BOSGAME system variants that reuse already-tracked AMD Strix Halo and Intel Panther Lake compute platforms. These records are system-level buying and deployment observations, not independent silicon architectures.

hardware.storage: 2TB NVMe SSD; 2x M.2 2280 PCIe 4.0 x4 slots

processor_power_w.evidence: AMD processor specification; not measured BOSGAME wall power

quantization_compatibility.gguf: practical through CPU/Vulkan/ROCm-capable llama.cpp-family paths; exact backend support depends on OS, driver and runtime version
quantization_compatibility.low_bit: 4-bit and 5-bit quantized LLMs are particularly relevant because weights share the unified memory pool
quantization_compatibility.evidence: platform/runtime guidance; not a vendor guarantee for every quantization format

model_size_practicality.assessment: high-capacity candidate, especially in the 128GB configuration
model_size_practicality.evidence: reasoned capacity assessment; runtime/context overhead still applies

model_size_practicality.assessment: AMD advertises the Ryzen AI Max+ 395 platform as capable of running local models up to 200B parameters under suitable software/quantization conditions; this is not a BOSGAME-specific throughput result

vendor_claims.claim: BOSGAME advertises up to 2.2x RTX 4090 AI performance in an LM Studio Llama 3 example
vendor_claims.caveat: The indexed product page does not provide enough model, quantization, context, prompt/decode split, power, or runtime metadata for normalized cross-platform comparison.

efficiency.note: Large unified memory at a 45-120W processor envelope is attractive for off-grid use, but BOSGAME whole-system idle/load wall power was not publicly verified in this pass.

pricing.configuration: M5 family, 96GB/128GB + 2TB; storefront collection advertises from US$2,399
pricing.note: This is the current family-level from-price; do not assume it applies to the 128GB selector.

pricing.configuration: 128GB LPDDR5X + 2TB SSD selector shown on product page
pricing.note: Product page displayed the 128GB selector with US$2,999 sale price when checked.

cost_efficiency.note: Price-per-memory is a simple acquisition metric and excludes SSD value, taxes, shipping and software performance.

hardware.notes: Shared Strix Halo silicon: compare the M5 against Framework Desktop, GMKtec EVO-X2/X3, Minisforum and other Ryzen AI Max+ 395 systems primarily on delivered price, thermals, networking, storage, warranty and measured wall power.

hardware.cpu: Intel Core Ultra X7 358H, 16C/16T, up to 4.8GHz
hardware.cpu_architecture: Intel Core Ultra Series 3 / Panther Lake

processor_power_w.evidence: Intel ARK processor specification; not measured BOSGAME wall power

quantization_compatibility.openvino: INT8 and other optimized model paths depend on OpenVINO model/runtime support
quantization_compatibility.gguf: CPU and portable GPU backends are possible, but Arc B390 llama.cpp/SYCL/Vulkan maturity should be measured rather than assumed from TOPS
quantization_compatibility.evidence: Intel framework support plus conservative runtime assessment

model_size_practicality.assessment: strong memory-capacity fit for a compact integrated system
model_size_practicality.evidence: reasoned capacity assessment; actual acceleration depends on backend support

model_size_practicality.assessment: capacity may be possible only with aggressive quantization and constrained context because the 64GB pool must also serve the OS/runtime; not recorded as a guaranteed fit

efficiency.note: Intel specifies a 25W processor base power and 80W maximum turbo power. Whole-system wall power and sustained Arc B390 LLM throughput were not publicly verified in this pass.

cost_efficiency.note: This metric values capacity only and should not be interpreted as a performance ranking against discrete GPUs or Strix Halo.

hardware.notes: The 122 GPU TOPS and 50 NPU TOPS are Intel peak INT8 figures, not LLM tokens/sec. Treat the VTI-490 as a compact high-memory Panther Lake system whose real local-LLM value depends on Arc B390 driver and runtime maturity.
